verdict.line: You lose if you facetank a full Apprehend pull into a 5-stack Hemorrhage combo, and you win if you burst in with Conqueror stacked and Valor back out before Darius resets pressure with Crippling Strike.

brief.thesis: Darius has one real engage tool — Apprehend (E), range 535, on a long 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s cooldown — and everything he does is built around landing it and stacking Hemorrhage to 5 for the enrage and the true-damage Guillotine. Riven has no way to out-range that pull, but she has three tools that break his rhythm once he's committed: Ki Burst's stun, Valor's damage block, and Broken Wings' burst-then-reset mobility. The matchup is close (54.3% over 624 games) because both champions are trying to win the same 2-3 second window — whoever lands their engage first usually wins the trade.

theirWindow.when: Apprehend (E) is up and you're in range
theirWindow.what: He pulls you in, Decimates for the blade-side damage and sustain, then Crippling Strike-slows you so you can't leave before Hemorrhage stacks up. Don't stand in his 535-range pull threat without a way to answer it.

yourWindow.when: Apprehend (E) is on cooldown or just whiffed
yourWindow.what: He has no way to close distance except walking, so this is when you initiate — Ki Burst to stun, Broken Wings in, autos to burn Runic Blade charges, then Valor out before he can Crippling Strike you.

start.why: Taken in 92.2% of games and wins at 55.2% — the extra sustain matters because Darius's Decimate and Hemorrhage bleed both chip you every exchange even when you dodge the pull.

boots.why: Most-picked boots at 54.9% WR; the cooldown reduction shortens Valor and Ki Burst, which are your only answers to a landed Apprehend.

core.why: Highest-winning core path (67% over 100 games) — its cooldown refund rewards the burst-in, Valor-out trade pattern this lane runs on.
Follow-up in the same top-WR path; scales your all-in damage as trades get longer through mid-game.
Converts Darius's physical burst and bleed damage into delayed damage you can heal back, which matters directly against a kit built around finishing you with true damage.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks over the course of a trade and converts to healing — matches the actual winning pattern here: burst in, hold the trade just long enough to stack Conqueror, then leave before his Hemorrhage stacks catch up.

summoners.why: Run in 98.2% of games at 54.4% WR. Ignite denies the healing off Decimate's blade hit and lets you close out short trades before Darius can stabilize back to full Hemorrhage stacks for a Guillotine reset.

playing.title: Track your own bleed stacks
playing.detail: Hemorrhage caps at 5 stacks and enrages Darius with a big Attack Damage boost when it does. Disengage before the 5th stack lands, not after.

playing.title: Engage only when Apprehend is down
playing.detail: Apprehend's cooldown is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s. Once he's used or missed it, he has no way to close distance except walking — that's your cue to start the fight, not wait for one.

playing.title: Valor through his Decimate swing
playing.detail: Valor steps you forward and blocks incoming damage during the dash. Time it to eat the Decimate swing rather than trading auto-for-auto into it.

playing.title: Burst and leave, don't facetank the slow
playing.detail: Land Ki Burst into Broken Wings and your Runic Blade-charged autos, then Valor away before Crippling Strike's next-hit slow lands — staying in range after he slows you is how the fight turns into a stack race he wins.

playing.title: Keep a Broken Wings charge in reserve
playing.detail: Broken Wings can be reactivated three times but the whole sequence shares one 13s cooldown. Don't dump all three charges just to engage — save at least one dash to get back out of his 535-range pull threat.

playing.title: Respect the Guillotine execute threshold
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks and its cooldown refreshes on a kill. At rank 5 that cooldown is just 6s, so never sit at low HP near him once he's fought you even once already this fight.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, summoner spells, and every win rate figure above are measured from live games on the current patch (OP.GG); the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and trade reasoning are my own read of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Bring Ignite when going against Darius. We recommend going in for a quick burst damage combo and falling back when your Conqueror’s stacks are up. Try to look for an opening while slowly using your [Q] ability.
